The worstest hostel in the world. Boorish business style
Jul 2017 • Business
I am a sport journalist from Saigon, southern Vietnam. I came to Dong Hoi for my business trip and stayed here for few days. I usually went out early and came back late for my job. EQUALLY SPEAKING , it was a nice place near the beach. HOWEVER, poor people, poor staffs, poor food, poor facilities, and the worst things I saw: "they was lacking of respect to their customers."

It can be said that "BOORISH VIETNAMESE BUSINESS STYLE".

1/ POOR STAFFS. The staffs thrown food of guests into the trash likes rubbish. Some of my roommates bought fruit and put it on the public table. They came into the room and came back in a 10 minutes later. They were really angry. Staffs had thrown their fruits into the trash instead of keeping it in the fridge or on their table. It was hardly understandable. 
2/ POOR FOOD. The breakfast was inedible. The chefs cooked perfunctory, just for done. 
3/ POOR FACILITIES: The toilet was dirty and smelled up. The shower was broken but still not fixed. The hot shower didn't work. When I complained to one of the staffs, she said she had talked to her oweners, but they don't care about these issues. 
 
I think that they don't respect their guests. They take money of their customers but serve them poor services. It was nothing to say if it was just broken. However, it had happened for a long time but didn't fix. Although the price is higher 1,4 times compared to the others.

In addition, there was a lot of mosquitos in the rooms. It was not cleaned up every day.

4/ BIKE RENTING OVERCHARGED. Bike renting is too expensive (200.000VND) compared to the average prices (from 100.000 to 120.000VND) in Quang Binh. 

I asked them to rent a motorbike. The staff took me 50.000VND because I only used a half day. However, 3 days later, another staff said me that they will charge 150.000VND instead of 50.000VND/Day. Because the price was 200.000VND/day. However, I used for long days so they took me off to 150.000VND.

What's a suprised. The highest prices in other tourism cities of Vietnam is just 120.000VND/Day. I quited their service and rent another bike with just 70.000VND/Day (lower 3 times).

5. BOORISH VIETNAMESE BUSINESSES STYLE: The worst thing happened when I checked out. They giving me a bill with the bike renting cost was 150.000VND/Day. Absolutely I disagreed. 

The first day when I asked them, the staff said it was 50.000VND. However 3 days later, another staff said it was 150.000VND. IF they said me it was 150.000VND since the first day, I will not used their service entirely. BUT, they only said the changed prices after 3 days. 

I didn't used their bike anymore and rent of the other with just 1/2 cost. In the bill they giving me, they charged me the later prices instead of their former. 

I totally not agreed. Then the staff said to me if I not agreed, she will not give me my passport. 

- No problem! She can keep my passport if she wants. :)

* She called to her owner for dealing the first and second times. They still kept the later prices (150.000VND/day)

- I absolutely not agreed.

* She called to her owner the second times. The owner said they charged me (50.000VND) for the first day and 100.000VND for 2nd and 3rd day.

- I absolutely not agreed.

* She called to her owner the fourth times and said her owner will come here to talk with me. 

- We didn't talk anymore and waited until 10 minutes later.. LOL.. they used a young guy to talk with me instead of the hostel's owner. :)

* He talked to me aggressively likes a gangster.

- You know, it was really an interesting conversation. "I never agree with the prices they given." 

* He said " Do you want come back home or stay here?"

- I explained to him " in other tourism cities in Vietnam, the hostels are quite friendly, honest and helpful. Many travelers prefer staying in the hostel rather than the hotel not only the saving cost but also the friendly and opened."

* You can't image what he said: "Don't compare the big city to this place. Each areas have a different way of doing business "

- I asked him: "Do you want your guest come back with you or they only come one times and go away? Do you like them recommend your service to their friends or not?"

* He kept silent.

-----------------------

FINALLY, I paid them 50.000VND for the first and 100.000VND for 2 second days. 

------------------------

I didn't forget to say "Good Luck" to them when leaving, but they just answered "Yes". :) 

It was not a good experience. !
